title: Never reuse class names from java.lang.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Object arrays are inferior to collections in almost every way. Prefer immutable collections (e.g., ImmutableSet, ImmutableList, etc.) over an object array whenever possible.
summary: It is an experimental check, so Error Prone does not turn it on by default.

title: Prefer using the enum-accepting rather than the int-accepting setter for enum fields.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.
